title: The Vehicle Addition Charge, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Premium Accounting
content:
The vehicle addition charge of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is the amount carried by the additional premium entry of a vehicle addition, for the term the addition falls in.

## Clause

The vehicle addition charge is the full-term charge of the vehicle times the excess-vehicle share, then times one less the loyalty credit percentage times its continuous-coverage share divided by 100, then times the charged days divided by the days of the vehicle's term. The product is rounded to the cent (half up) once, at the end, with no intermediate rounding.

## Definitions

- **Full-term charge of the vehicle.** The full-term premium after the vehicle addition less the full-term premium before it, both as recorded on the vehicle addition entry.
- **Days of the vehicle's term.** Counted in calendar days from the term effective date to the term expiration date of the term the vehicle addition falls in.
- **Charged days.** The calendar days from the date the vehicle addition was recorded to the term expiration date.
- **Excess-vehicle share, loyalty credit percentage and continuous-coverage share.** For a vehicle addition the excess-vehicle share is one, and the loyalty credit percentage and its continuous-coverage share are each nil.

## Inputs and their records

| Quantity | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Full-term premium before and after | The vehicle addition entry in the policy's transaction history |
| Date the addition was recorded | The vehicle addition entry |
| Term effective date and term expiration date | The policy record, for the term the addition falls in |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A vehicle addition entry shows a full-term premium of 1100.00 before the addition and 1400.00 after it. It was recorded on 1 March 2026, in a term running from 1 January 2026 to 1 July 2026.

1. Full-term charge: 1400.00 less 1100.00, which is 300.00.
2. Days of the vehicle's term: 1 January to 1 July 2026, which is 181 calendar days.
3. Charged days: 1 March to 1 July 2026, which is 122 calendar days.
4. Charge: 300.00 times one, times one less nil, times 122 divided by 181. That is 202.2099…, rounded once to 202.21.

Rounding happens only at the end: 300.00 times 122 divided by 181 is carried unrounded until the final cent.
